subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessionClosedAt` as the canonical durable session-entry marker and reserved plugin-slot key for closed transport thread rollover?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and covered, but the new persisted key becomes a compatibility contract for upgrades and external plugin session-entry slots, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept durable marker
options.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as core-owned closed-thread lifecycle state and land after a current-main refresh with green exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep state narrower
options.body: Ask for a redesign that keeps closed-thread state plugin-owned or otherwise avoids reserving a new core session-entry key.

options.title: Pause for session-state design
options.body: Hold this PR until broader persisted session-state and plugin-slot ownership direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept durable marker
recommendation.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as core-owned closed-thread lifecycle state and land after a current-main refresh with green exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on session controls, durable session-entry fields, and cross-surface session-state contracts.
